html:
Quest Giver: Ticked Tomb Curator

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 10 Looters there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Ticked Tomb Curator

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Tomb Looters - Level 2

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 10 Looters there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Oh noes is me! My favorite Dungeon Runner posse has finally met their end at the claws of Ratsputin. The AFK Bolsheviks were one of the best posses on the server, especially at farming bosses, but they finally met their match. It happened during a particularly Insane!(TM) fight with Ratsputin where the three founding members of the AFK Bolshevists fell and never respawned. Ever since that fateful battle they don't respond to /whisper anymore...and I am fearing the worst! It is rumored that they had 'families' and 'responsibilities' but I don't know what those words mean.

The Townston Commander had three tombs built in Ratsputin's Gulag so that future Dungeon Runners and posse members will have a place to go to mourn the fallen heroes and pay tribute to them. I'm proud to say that the Townston Commander chose me to take care of the tombs, although it hasn't gone very well lately. The tombs have fallen under the control of the heartless monsters within the dungeon. Will you help to restore order to these hallowed monuments?

There is a tomb, the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist, on Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag that is currently occupied by a notorious group of looters that call themselves...Looters. In order to clear the tomb of these unworthy squatters I need you to slay 10 of these so called Looters. While you are there you should also pay respect to the fallen posse member. Some Dungeon Runners lay King's Coins in the eyes of the statue and some just rub the monument for luck. When you have done this task return to me, the Ticked Tomb Curator, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell. Good luck!

Turn-in:

You have slain the Looters in the tomb? Oh, thank you so much. Unfortunately the Looters are a stubborn group and your work here is not complete...yet.

Objectives:

  • Slay Looters

Level range: 78–100
